nodes.title: INFO
widgets_values:
This workflow and custom nodes allows you to quickly generate different takes and then select the ones you want to upscale using the saved latents.


***How to use***

-Set the folder path to save the previews and the folders containing the different takes.

-Enable the Generate group and disable the Upscale group using the Fast Groups Muter node in the Setup group.

-Generate different takes.

-Disable the Generate group, enable the Upscale group.

-Select the takes you want to upscale using the Handy Tools LTX Load Latents tool.
